sentences.en: The committee can only act in an advisory capacity.
sentences.zh: 委员会只能以顾问的身份行事。

sentences.en: A wind advisory is in effect until the storm front passes.
sentences.zh: 大风预警生效，直到风暴过去。

sentences.en: I received an advisory notice about my electricity cutting off this month.
sentences.zh: 我收到了关于本月将要停电的咨询通知。

senses.zh: 顾问的，咨询的；建议性的，劝告性的
